I’d prefer saved-search names to be unique so two identical-looking chips can’t be confused. If I reuse a name, prompt me to choose another rather than silently creating a duplicate.

A saved search referring to a tag that no longer exists can simply return no results. It isn’t broken, and it should start matching again if that tag is used later.

The rest of the edge-case behaviour sounds right. Please bring back the complete scope.
